- Fix GitHub downloads in the PS5 updater.
- Add a Settings scrollbar and move Updates to the bottom.
- Show brief release notes before downloading.
- Improve Discover frame pacing, catalog browsing and request management.

Install the complete folder ZIP in `/data/homebrew/PPSA99001`. Versions through
01.000.006 require this one-time folder upgrade to fix their updater. Later builds
can use Settings → Updates with ELF Loader running. Login and preferences are preserved.
